fusions.name: Velvet Rub
fusions.desc: Rakes branching tines down the target and deals 5 damage, stripping 8% of its armour for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Rack Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps your branching rack in a full circle and deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Understory Dash
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Second Spring
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 15 stamina at once. Once every 30 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
